question: Among living patients whose last names begin with "A" and who each have exactly one distinct condition, which eight conditions have the highest number of different active medications prescribed to any single patient, and what are their corresponding codes?
sql:
-- For each condition, find the max number of different active medications 
-- prescribed to any single patient with that condition
WITH living_A_patients AS (
  SELECT p.id as patient_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient` p
  WHERE (SELECT n.family FROM UNNEST(p.name) n LIMIT 1) LIKE 'A%'
    AND (p.deceased IS NULL OR p.deceased.boolean = FALSE)
),
patients_with_one_condition AS (
  SELECT c.subject.patientId as patient_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) as condition_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
  WHERE c.subject.patientId IN (SELECT patient_id FROM living_A_patients)
  GROUP BY c.subject.patientId
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) = 1
),
patient_conditions AS (
  SELECT c.subject.patientId as patient_id,
         c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code as condition_code,
         c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].display as condition_display
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
  WHERE c.subject.patientId IN (SELECT patient_id FROM patients_with_one_condition)
),
patient_active_meds AS (
  SELECT mr.subject.patientId as patient_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) as active_med_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request` mr
  WHERE mr.status = 'active'
    AND mr.subject.patientId IN (SELECT patient_id FROM patients_with_one_condition)
  GROUP BY mr.subject.patientId
)
SELECT pc.condition_code,
       pc.condition_display,
       MAX(COALESCE(pam.active_med_count, 0)) as max_active_meds
FROM patient_conditions pc
LEFT JOIN patient_active_meds pam ON pc.patient_id = pam.patient_id
GROUP BY pc.condition_code, pc.condition_display
ORDER BY max_active_meds DESC
LIMIT 8
